create_command_instance: create a Command dataclass instance with a code string, name, and optional docstring
create_multiline_command: create a Command with an end_name to represent a multi-line command block
create_command_with_arguments: create a Command instance that includes a dictionary of arguments for parameterized execution
serialize_command: serialize a Command dataclass to JSON using the FrozenSerializable parent class
review_command_dataclass: review the Command frozen dataclass fields including code, name, docstring, end_name, arguments, and signature
